findings.summary: Constructor and method argument evaluation duplicated the same parameter validation and caller-scope compilation path; consolidated it into one class-call helper.
Fetched Canvas2D atlas compilation enumerated the same closed PNG directory twice; the bake now returns the enumerated image set with its pixels.
Keyboard modifier property lookup allocated an identical Map on every compiler property read; moved the mapping to shared module state.
The static-loop range helper exposed an unused declaration field and scanned nested loops even for required scene-construction iteration; removed both redundant operations.
Native decimal parsing and voxel JSON parsing duplicated ASCII whitespace recognition and copied the complete save payload into the reader; shared the predicate and moved the payload.

Optional property lowering reevaluated the same nullable object lookup for its presence test and property read; bound it once to preserve JavaScript single-evaluation semantics and reduce work in voxel lighting.

The voxel crosshair's layered gradients were malformed by the RmlUi projection; lower the reviewed shape to the same retained inner-RML bar representation already used by Doom instead of adding a second rendering primitive.

Live SDL input and deterministic replay both need the browser host's Escape-to-release pointer-lock rule; share one transition helper and make replay deliver the same canvas click callback as live mouse input.

Platform listener lowering split pointer movement by event spelling and target, silently erasing document mousemove; route mousemove and pointermove for window, document, and canvas through the same native mouse-move callback.

Canvas click lowering reused the broader window pointer-down callback, allowing non-client window decorations to request pointer lock; separate canvas clicks and share one client-bound press/release dispatcher between live input and replay.

Voxel save/load had a scene-specific fixed-path boundary; move host path selection into the PAL while retaining one compact JSON serializer/parser and add environment overrides for deterministic diagnostics.
Windows file dialogs return Unicode paths while the portable PAL exposes UTF-8; construct C++20 filesystem paths from u8string before opening streams so non-ASCII directories remain valid.

The keyboard adapter omitted the complete function-key range and replay could not express modifiers; add the standard F1-F12 mapping and one generic Ctrl-prefixed replay form instead of demo-specific shortcuts.
